title: Team & Access
description: Invite teammates, assign roles, and review everything that has been changed.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full access. Billing, team, danger-zone settings.

dietitian.label: Dietitian
dietitian.description: Manage clients, plans, appointments and journal.

intern.label: Intern
intern.description: Read-only on clients; can draft plans for review.

reception.label: Reception
reception.description: Booking, intake forms and basic client info only.

assistant.label: Assistant (legacy)
assistant.description: Retired role — migrate these users to reception.

members.removeBody: They lose access immediately, including any session they already have open. Their account is kept rather than deleted, so past appointments and audit entries still show who they were, and their email address stays reserved.
